comment: glTF core PBR permutation matrix (plan F1 Task 4, spec K-A / 6.1). Axes: TIER x FG_SKIN x FG_MORPH x FG_UNLIT = 24 define sets per stage. Each target compiles the define sets of its backend tier(s) (spec 6.1): 8 per tier per target per stage; dxbc has two tiers since plan F2 Task 7 (T0 = SM 4.0 for D3D11 FL10_x, T1 = SM 5.0 for FL11_x), so 64 per stage, 128 compiles in all. scripts/compile_shaders.py checks that 'excluded' is exactly the complement of 'tiers'.

dxbc.backend: D3D11 FL10_x (TIER 0: SM 4.0) and FL11_x (TIER 1: SM 5.0)

excluded.reason: GLSL ES 3.00 has no storage buffers (T0, spec 6.1); shaderc rejects them by name
